s4958: Which of these road signs marks a road on which route vehicles travel in a specially reserved lane in the same direction as the general flow of traffic?
s4959: According to paragraph 5.14 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.14 "Lane for route vehicles" marks a road on which route vehicles travel in a specially reserved lane in the same direction as the general flow of traffic. The sign applies to the lane over which it is placed. A sign placed on the right-hand side of the road applies to the far-right lane of the carriageway.

s4962: According to paragraph 5.14 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.14 "Lane for route vehicles" marks a road on which route vehicles travel in a specially reserved lane in the same direction as the general flow of traffic. s4963: Which of these road signs marks an area (zone) where the rules for traffic in residential zones apply?
s4964: According to paragraph 5.21 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.21 "Residential zone" marks an area (zone) where the rules for traffic in residential zones apply. The sign is placed at every entrance to a residential zone.
s4965: Which of these road signs mark the start of a built-up area where the rules for traffic in built-up areas apply?

s4969: Which of these road signs marks an area within which the maximum speed is limited?
s4970: According to paragraphs 5.27 and 5.29 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.31 "Maximum speed limit zone" marks an area within which the maximum speed is limited.

s4979: Which identification sign is fixed to the front and rear of a vehicle carrying an oversized (large) load?
s4980: According to subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, and in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: d) "Oversized (large) load": a 400x400 mm plate with alternating red and white stripes 50 mm wide drawn diagonally on it, with a retroreflective surface, fixed to the front and rear of oversized (large) vehicles and of the vehicles specified in paragraph 13 of Article 47 of this Law.
s4981: Which identification sign is fixed to the rear of a vehicle that is more than 20 metres long with or without its load, and to a road train with two or more trailers?
s4982: According to subparagraph "e" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, and in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: e) "Long vehicle": a yellow rectangle of at least 1200x200 mm with a red border 40 mm wide and a retroreflective surface, fixed to the rear of an oversized (large) vehicle whose length with or without its load exceeds 20 metres, and also to a vehicle combination with two or more trailers. If a sign of this size cannot be fixed, two identical signs of at least 600x200 mm may be fixed symmetrically about the vehicle's axis.
s4983: Which of these identification signs is fixed to the front and rear of a bus carrying a group of children?
s4984: According to subparagraph "f" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, and in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: f) "Transporting children": a yellow square with a red border (each side of the square at least 250 mm, the border 1/10 of the side wide), showing the symbol of road sign 1.24 in black, fixed to the front and rear of a bus carrying groups of children.
s4985: Which of these road signs gives information about the general speed limits in force on the roads of Georgia?
s4986: Which of these road signs shows the speed at which it is recommended to drive on this section of road?
s4987: According to paragraph 7.2 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 7.2 "Recommended speed" shows the speed at which it is recommended to drive on that section of road. The sign is placed at the start of the road. It applies up to the nearest intersection, and when used together with a warning sign, along the whole length of the dangerous section.
s4988: Which of these road signs marks an area where only pedestrians are allowed to move?
s4989: According to paragraph 5.33 of Chapter 5 (Special regulation signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 5.33 "Pedestrian zone" marks an area where only pedestrians are allowed to move.
s4990: Which of these road signs marks a road with no through exit?
s4991: According to paragraphs 7.8.1-7.8.3 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road signs 7.8.1-7.8.3 "Dead end" mark a road with no through exit. Sign 7.8.1 is placed at the start of the road, and signs 7.8.2 and 7.8.3 before the junction with the road that has no through exit.
s4992: Within the zone of which of these road signs is a left turn not allowed?

s5022: According to paragraph 5 of Article 32 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, except when turning to exit an intersection where roundabout traffic is organised, before turning right or left, and also before making a U-turn, the driver of a vehicle must move in good time into the appropriate outermost position on the carriageway intended for traffic in that direction. When vehicles travelling in the same direction change lanes at the same time and their paths cross, the driver of the vehicle on the right has priority.
s5034: Is the driver prohibited from making a U-turn in the direction of the arrow if visibility is limited to 90 metres?

According to paragraphs 10 and 11 of the same Article: 10. If, when making a U-turn outside an intersection, the carriageway is not wide enough to turn from the far-left position, the manoeuvre may be made from the right-hand edge of the carriageway or from the right-hand shoulder. If the carriageway at an intersection is not wide enough to make a U-turn from the far-left position, the driver must make this manoeuvre beyond the intersection, unless the width of the road near the intersection does not allow this.
